item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02970","case1_error":"Reports unsupported 13 after a correct average formula; the average is 9.","case2_error":"“Three times more” ambiguously means three times as many or an additional threefold amount; 320 follows the former interpretation.","reason":"Case 1 has an unsupported final number, but case 2 depends on materially ambiguous wording.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02971","case1_error":"Correctly derives $12 per chair but gives $20 in the leading marker and conclusion, creating an answer conflict.","case2_error":"Replaces the stated one plank per leg with three, inflating the required wood.","reason":"Case 1 contains a correct derivation with conflicting answers, so it does not establish a comparable mathematical error mechanism.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02972","case1_error":"Gives unsupported 13 after the correct average formula, which yields 9.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final numbers ending in 322.5 after formulas that yield weekly earnings of $675.","reason":"Both present correct formulas followed by unsupported incorrect final numbers; neither shows a faulty numerical evaluation.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J02973","case1_error":"Treats ten ads per company as ten ads overall, omitting the factor of three companies.","case2_error":"Treats the square's full area as one side's area and multiplies it by four.","reason":"Case 1 omits aggregation across companies; case 2 misinterprets square geometry and counts the full base area four times.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02974","case1_error":"Uses Jack's current apples divided by Jack's capacity, 8/12, instead of Jill's capacity divided by his current apples, 24/8.","case2_error":"Adds only one year's net migration to ten years of births, omitting the ten-year multiplier.","reason":"Case 1 forms the wrong comparison ratio; case 2 fails to accumulate an annual population change over the specified duration.","judgment":"different"}]}
